import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import glob
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_log_error
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

np.random.seed(42)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load training and test data
df_train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
df_test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

if os.path.exists("./input/sample_submission.csv"):
    sample_df = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
else:
    sample_df = None

# Prepare feature data
feature_cols = ["lv1", "lv2", "lv3", "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "x", "y", "z"]
categorical_cols = ["spacegroup"]

# Extract composition ratios as features
train_composition = (
    df_train.groupby("spacegroup")[feature_cols + categorical_cols].mean().reset_index()
)
test_composition = (
    df_test.groupby("spacegroup")[feature_cols + categorical_cols].sum().reset_index()
)

# One-hot encode spacegroup
try:
    cat_enc = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore")
    cat_enc.fit(pd.DataFrame({"spacegroup": df_train["spacegroup"]}))
    train_cat = cat_enc.transform(
        pd.DataFrame({"spacegroup": df_train["spacegroup"]})
    ).toarray()
    test_cat = cat_enc.transform(
        pd.DataFrame({"spacegroup": df_test["spacegroup"]})
    ).toarray()
except:
    train_cat = np.array([[0]])
    test_cat = np.array([[0]])

# Scale numeric features
scaler = StandardScaler()
train_num = scaler.fit_transform(
    train_composition[feature_cols + categorical_cols].values
)
test_num = scaler.transform(test_composition[feature_cols + categorical_cols].values)

# Combine features
X_train = np.hstack([train_num, train_cat])
X_test = np.hstack([test_num, test_cat])

y_target = df_train[
    (
        [col for col in ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]]
        if "formation_energy_ev_natom" in df_train.columns
        else [df_train.columns[i] for i in range(len(df_train.columns) - 1)]
    )
]

# Train model on combined features
model = RandomForestRegressor(
    n_estimators=100, max_depth=10, min_samples_split=5, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train, y_target.values.ravel())

# Holdout validation and prediction
X_val_idx = int(len(X_train) * 0.7)
X_train_fold = X_train[:X_val_idx]
X_val_fold = X_train[X_val_idx:]
y_train_fold = y_target.iloc[:X_val_idx].values.ravel()
y_val_fold = y_target.iloc[X_val_idx:].values.ravel()

val_preds = model.predict(X_val_fold)
validation_rmse = np.mean(
    mean_squared_log_error(y_train_fold, val_preds).reshape(-1, 1)
)
test_rmse = np.mean(mean_squared_log_error(y_train_fold, val_preds).reshape(-1, 1))

print(f"Validation RMSLE: {validation_rmse:.4f}")

# Predict test set
test_target = df_test[
    (
        [col for col in ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]]
        if "formation_energy_ev_natom" in df_test.columns
        else [df_test.columns[i] for i in range(len(df_test.columns) - 1)]
    )
]

sub_preds = model.predict(X_test)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": df_test["id"].values})
submission_df["formation_energy_ev_natom"] = sub_preds[:, 0]
submission_df["bandgap_energy_ev"] = sub_preds[:, 1]
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved with total predictions length: {len(submission_df)}")
